1. (Currently Amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor, wherein the escalated alarm is __distinct from and more urgent than__ the first alarm.

(Currently Amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition and to track escalation status of the alarm; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, and __escalation level information__; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data.

17. (Original)

18. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises __information about a current level of escalation of the alarm and whether the alarm has been acknowledged at each escalation level__.

19. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises __information about acknowledgement status of the alarm at each escalation level__.

20. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data __including escalation status__ to one or more wireless devices __when the alarm reaches a predetermined escalation level__.
